title: New insights into the mechanism of ammonia toxicity: Focus on Cactus.
authors: Huang, Yi; Wang, Shuping; Fan, Juntao; Pan, Jinfen; Zhou, Quan; Xu, Jiayun; Wang, Jie; Zhang, Tianxu; Yan, Zhenguang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氨暴露下Cactus（IκB同源物）对NF-κB信号通路的调控，仅用分子对接模拟Cactus与NH3结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: The NF-kappaB signaling pathway is the most critical pathway in innate immunity. IkappaB (Cactus) is the primary cytoplasmic inhibitor of NF-kappaB (Dorsal). In this study, we found that ammonia exposure could significantly induce the expression of Cactus, in a dose-dependent manner in different tissues, with the highest expression in the gill of Corbicula fluminea. The expression pattern-related elements (Tube and Dorsal) in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway were also analyzed, showing significant up-regulation in 48 h. There was an inhibitory effect between up-regulated Cactus and Dorsal in 72 h, which may regulate Dorsal as a negative feedback pathway function to control the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha). Besides, through molecular docking simulation, we found that the Cactus could be directly activated by NH(3), complementing the regulatory mechanism of the Cactus. To further test our hypothesis, the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines decreased after adding PDTC (the antioxidant of Cactus/IkappaB), suggesting that PDTC can prevent the degradation of Cactus, inhibit Dorsal translocating into the nucleus, and activate the pro-inflammatory cytokines. This revealed the inhibitory effect of Cactus on activating Dorsal/NF-kappaB factors in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Thus, we suggested that the Cactus is an essential regulator of ammonia-activated inflammation in C. fluminea, which was reported to be activated only by bacteria and immune stimulators. Our study provides a new perspective on the mechanism of ammonia toxicity in invertebrates.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB信号通路是先天免疫中最关键的信号通路。IkappaB（Cactus）是NF-kappaB（Dorsal）的主要细胞质抑制剂。在本研究中，我们发现氨暴露能够显著诱导Cactus的表达，在不同组织中呈剂量依赖性，且在河蚬（Corbicula fluminea）的鳃中表达最高。我们还分析了NF-kappaB信号通路中与表达模式相关的元件（Tube和Dorsal），显示其在48小时显著上调。在72小时，上调的Cactus与Dorsal之间存在抑制作用，这可能通过负反馈通路调节Dorsal，以控制促炎细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）的表达。此外，通过分子对接模拟，我们发现Cactus可以被NH(3)直接激活，补充了Cactus的调控机制。为进一步验证我们的假设，在添加PDTC（Cactus/IkappaB的抗氧化剂）后，促炎细胞因子水平下降，表明PDTC可以阻止Cactus降解，抑制Dorsal转位进入细胞核，并激活促炎细胞因子。这揭示了Cactus在NF-kappaB信号通路中对激活Dorsal/NF-kappaB因子的抑制作用。因此，我们提出Cactus是河蚬中氨激活炎症的关键调节因子，而此前报道其仅被细菌和免疫刺激物激活。我们的研究为无脊椎动物氨毒性机制提供了新视角。
